🌅 THERE IS HOPE FOR THE DEAD — A RESURRECTION IS COMING!

Have you lost someone you dearly love? Have you ever wondered:

❓ Why will the dead be resurrected?
❓ When will they be resurrected?
❓ What will happen after they are awakened?

Jesus gave this wonderful promise:

“The hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice, and shall come forth.” — John 5:28,29

🌿 WHY WILL THE DEAD BE RESURRECTED?

Because Jesus died as the Ransom for Adam and his race.

“The man Christ Jesus; who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.” — 1 Timothy 2:5,6

Through Adam, the human family came under sin and death. But through Christ, God provided redemption.

“For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.” — 1 Corinthians 15:22

The billions sleeping in death have therefore not been forgotten by God.

Jesus purchased the human family with His precious life, and the resurrection is part of the great purpose for which He died.

⏰ WHEN WILL THEY BE RESURRECTED?

The Bible points to Christ’s Kingdom as the great period for mankind’s resurrection and restoration.

Peter called it:

“The times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.” — Acts 3:19-21

The Church has the special “first resurrection.” — Revelation 20:6.

Then comes the great work of blessing mankind during Christ’s thousand-year Kingdom.

Jesus said:

“All that are in the graves shall hear his voice, and shall come forth.” — John 5:28,29

And Paul declared:

“There shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.” — Acts 24:15

🌍 BUT WHY BRING BACK THE UNJUST?

This is one of the beautiful features of God’s Plan.

They are not awakened merely to be told that they were sinners and then immediately condemned again.

They are awakened to receive an opportunity to learn righteousness under the righteous government of Christ.

“When thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.” — Isaiah 26:9

Many died without ever receiving a full knowledge of God and His gracious Plan.

But God:

“Will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.” — 1 Timothy 2:4

Their awakening from the grave will therefore be the beginning, not the completion, of their resurrection.

🌱 WHAT WILL THEY BE RESURRECTED TO DO?

They will have the opportunity to learn, obey, reform their characters, and gradually rise out of the effects of sin and death.

Jesus said:

“I am the resurrection, and the life.” — John 11:25

Under Christ’s Kingdom mankind will be given the opportunity to walk on the “way of holiness.”

“And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness.” — Isaiah 35:8

Think of it!

🌿 The ignorant will be taught.
🌿 The blind eyes of understanding will be opened.
🌿 Mankind will learn righteousness.
🌿 Satan’s deceptive influence will be restrained.
🌿 The willing and obedient will progress toward human perfection.
🌿 Ultimately, death itself will be destroyed.

“The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.” — 1 Corinthians 15:26

This is why the Bible speaks not merely of an awakening, but of RESTITUTION — restoration of that which was lost through Adam.

❤️ WHAT A HOPE FOR OUR DEAD LOVED ONES!

The cemetery is not God’s final purpose for humanity.

The grave is not the end.

A glorious resurrection morning is coming!

“Thy dead men shall live.” — Isaiah 26:19

“And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death.” — Revelation 21:4

Jesus paid the Ransom.
Christ’s Kingdom is coming.
The dead will be awakened.
Mankind will be taught righteousness.
The obedient will have the opportunity to attain everlasting life.

🌅 THERE IS HOPE BEYOND THE GRAVE!

🌅 THERE IS HOPE FOR THE DEAD — A RESURRECTION IS COMING!

Have you lost someone you dearly love? Have you ever wondered:

❓ Why will the dead be resurrected?
❓ When will they be resurrected?
❓ What will happen after they are awakened?

Jesus gave this wonderful promise:

“The hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice, and shall come forth.” — John 5:28,29

🌿 WHY WILL THE DEAD BE RESURRECTED?

Because Jesus died as the Ransom for Adam and his race.

“The man Christ Jesus; who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.” — 1 Timothy 2:5,6

Through Adam, the human family came under sin and death. But through Christ, God provided redemption.

“For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.” — 1 Corinthians 15:22

The billions sleeping in death have therefore not been forgotten by God.

Jesus purchased the human family with His precious life, and the resurrection is part of the great purpose for which He died.

⏰ WHEN WILL THEY BE RESURRECTED?

The Bible points to Christ’s Kingdom as the great period for mankind’s resurrection and restoration.

Peter called it:

“The times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.” — Acts 3:19-21

The Church has the special “first resurrection.” — Revelation 20:6.

Then comes the great work of blessing mankind during Christ’s thousand-year Kingdom.

Jesus said:

“All that are in the graves shall hear his voice, and shall come forth.” — John 5:28,29

And Paul declared:

“There shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.” — Acts 24:15

🌍 BUT WHY BRING BACK THE UNJUST?

This is one of the beautiful features of God’s Plan.

They are not awakened merely to be told that they were sinners and then immediately condemned again.

They are awakened to receive an opportunity to learn righteousness under the righteous government of Christ.

“When thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.” — Isaiah 26:9

Many died without ever receiving a full knowledge of God and His gracious Plan.

But God:

“Will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.” — 1 Timothy 2:4

Their awakening from the grave will therefore be the beginning, not the completion, of their resurrection.

🌱 WHAT WILL THEY BE RESURRECTED TO DO?

They will have the opportunity to learn, obey, reform their characters, and gradually rise out of the effects of sin and death.

Jesus said:

“I am the resurrection, and the life.” — John 11:25

Under Christ’s Kingdom mankind will be given the opportunity to walk on the “way of holiness.”

“And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness.” — Isaiah 35:8

Think of it!

🌿 The ignorant will be taught.
🌿 The blind eyes of understanding will be opened.
🌿 Mankind will learn righteousness.
🌿 Satan’s deceptive influence will be restrained.
🌿 The willing and obedient will progress toward human perfection.
🌿 Ultimately, death itself will be destroyed.

“The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.” — 1 Corinthians 15:26

This is why the Bible speaks not merely of an awakening, but of RESTITUTION — restoration of that which was lost through Adam.

❤️ WHAT A HOPE FOR OUR DEAD LOVED ONES!

The cemetery is not God’s final purpose for humanity.

The grave is not the end.

A glorious resurrection morning is coming!

“Thy dead men shall live.” — Isaiah 26:19

“And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death.” — Revelation 21:4

Jesus paid the Ransom.
Christ’s Kingdom is coming.
The dead will be awakened.
Mankind will be taught righteousness.
The obedient will have the opportunity to attain everlasting life.

🌅 THERE IS HOPE BEYOND THE GRAVE!

🌅 THERE IS HOPE FOR THE DEAD — A RESURRECTION IS COMING!

Have you lost someone you dearly love? Have you ever wondered:

❓ Why will the dead be resurrected?
❓ When will they be resurrected?
❓ What will happen after they are awakened?

Jesus gave this wonderful promise:

“The hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice, and shall come forth.” — John 5:28,29

🌿 WHY WILL THE DEAD BE RESURRECTED?

Because Jesus died as the Ransom for Adam and his race.

“The man Christ Jesus; who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.” — 1 Timothy 2:5,6

Through Adam, the human family came under sin and death. But through Christ, God provided redemption.

“For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.” — 1 Corinthians 15:22

The billions sleeping in death have therefore not been forgotten by God.

Jesus purchased the human family with His precious life, and the resurrection is part of the great purpose for which He died.

⏰ WHEN WILL THEY BE RESURRECTED?

The Bible points to Christ’s Kingdom as the great period for mankind’s resurrection and restoration.

Peter called it:

“The times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.” — Acts 3:19-21

The Church has the special “first resurrection.” — Revelation 20:6.

Then comes the great work of blessing mankind during Christ’s thousand-year Kingdom.

Jesus said:

“All that are in the graves shall hear his voice, and shall come forth.” — John 5:28,29

And Paul declared:

“There shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.” — Acts 24:15

🌍 BUT WHY BRING BACK THE UNJUST?

This is one of the beautiful features of God’s Plan.

They are not awakened merely to be told that they were sinners and then immediately condemned again.

They are awakened to receive an opportunity to learn righteousness under the righteous government of Christ.

“When thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.” — Isaiah 26:9

Many died without ever receiving a full knowledge of God and His gracious Plan.

But God:

“Will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.” — 1 Timothy 2:4

Their awakening from the grave will therefore be the beginning, not the completion, of their resurrection.

🌱 WHAT WILL THEY BE RESURRECTED TO DO?

They will have the opportunity to learn, obey, reform their characters, and gradually rise out of the effects of sin and death.

Jesus said:

“I am the resurrection, and the life.” — John 11:25

Under Christ’s Kingdom mankind will be given the opportunity to walk on the “way of holiness.”

“And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness.” — Isaiah 35:8

Think of it!

🌿 The ignorant will be taught.
🌿 The blind eyes of understanding will be opened.
🌿 Mankind will learn righteousness.
🌿 Satan’s deceptive influence will be restrained.
🌿 The willing and obedient will progress toward human perfection.
🌿 Ultimately, death itself will be destroyed.

“The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.” — 1 Corinthians 15:26

This is why the Bible speaks not merely of an awakening, but of RESTITUTION — restoration of that which was lost through Adam.

❤️ WHAT A HOPE FOR OUR DEAD LOVED ONES!

The cemetery is not God’s final purpose for humanity.

The grave is not the end.

A glorious resurrection morning is coming!

“Thy dead men shall live.” — Isaiah 26:19

“And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death.” — Revelation 21:4

Jesus paid the Ransom.
Christ’s Kingdom is coming.
The dead will be awakened.
Mankind will be taught righteousness.
The obedient will have the opportunity to attain everlasting life.

🌅 THERE IS HOPE BEYOND THE GRAVE!
